usage: xo serve [--socket=path] [stop|status]

Keep checked programs in memory and answer xo check and xo query over a
unix socket (default $XO_SERVE_SOCKET or <user cache dir>/xo/serve.sock).
check and query use a running server automatically; XO_NO_SERVE=1 turns
that off. stop shuts the server down; status prints its cache counters.
